_calibration: UFD refs (refs/ufd/calibration_metrics.csv). Impact: share of the striking limb's path in the last 2 frames before contact - Ryu fsmash 78%, Terry ftilt 100%, Mario jab 100%, Little Mac fsmash 45% (it lunges during the build) -> min 40%; an even 8-frame move scores 25%. Hold: 2 settle frames, then >= 60% extended and < 6% of the reach per frame. Recoil required only for smashes (owner's Ryu example).
_note_forward_tilt: Owner 2026-10-31: 'Forward tilt è il nome della mossa' - Terry's ftilt is the example of impact spacing (long ease-in, 1-2 frame arrival), not a spine-lean target. Spine tilt is info only.
_wrist_calibration: v8 (owner: rear fist bent inward all clip, front fist frozen at frame 3): rear flex +38..+69 and dev up to 35; front frame 3 flex +86 dev +77, hand turned 5 deg while the forearm turned 82. v9 (fists lined up, 10 deg curl): flex +8..+16, dev <= 11. Owner's blockout guard: front +31 flex.
_elbow_calibration: v9 (owner 31/10 17:46: left elbow pointing outward, unnatural, geometry defect): lead upper arm raised 55-65 deg with the elbow pole nearly horizontal (up -0.11..-0.27) on frames 4-10; guard frames pole up -0.5..-0.7, elevation 12-37. v7 frames 4-8: elevation 30-43, pole up -0.22..-0.44. Contact (arm extended along the punch) accepted as exaggeration. Hand roll: the blockout's corkscrew (about -160 deg at contact) is inside the action frames; outside them > 120 deg or > 60 deg/frame flags.
_note_elbow_pole_min_elevation: Ganondorf ftilt 31/10: the 'elbow points down' rule applies from 40 deg of upper-arm elevation; a hanging arm's bent elbow points back (natural). v8/v9 chamber (55-65 deg) still fails.
_note_balance: Owner 31/10 (Ganondorf v1: 'completely unbalanced and weightless'): centre of mass over the planted feet (support polygon, 2 cm tolerance); on one foot over that foot. Declared lunges/falls/airborne frames exempt (move sheet balance_exempt_frames). Kicks: the upper body counter-moves (back) from the anticipation key to contact. v1: 3-25 cm outside on frames 2-26, upper body +5.5 cm with the kick: fails.
_note_support_knee: Owner 31/10 ('why is the rear leg bent like that?'): on one foot the support knee bends <= 60 deg unless the move sheet declares crouch: true. v1: 89-99 deg (near-kneel): fails. The two-foot guard stance is not judged by this rule.
_note_pose_rules: pose_rules.py (coordinator's posing checklist, 31/10): lift-off weight shift, support knee 10-45 deg on one foot, kick kinetic chain pelvis->thigh->shin->foot, no twinning at contact/mid-hold, head toward the target through strike and hold, planted foot slide <= 0.5 cm.
_note_kick_weight: Kicks: weight into the kick = pelvis drive from its furthest-back point to contact >= com_shift_min_cm; the whole-body centre of mass stays over the support foot (balance); the upper body leans back relative to the hips >= counterbalance_min_cm (31/10).
_curves_doc: motion_curves.py / motion_ref.py: still share = a hand/foot's share of the limb path over startup+active; corr = velocity correlation for with/counter; ref_* = against the reference's 2D keypoints (body lengths); see motion_ref.py
_note_elbow_ext: Ganondorf ftilt v3 (01/11): an upper arm swept BACK (more back than sideways from the chest frame) is shoulder extension, its bent elbow points back/up naturally; the chicken-wing (50 deg) and elbow-up rules apply to arms raised forward or sideways, a swept-back arm is limited at 65 deg (extension range ~50-60 + exaggeration). The reference's rear arm: 55-57 deg back.
